name: CIA DSL
summary: ADSL arm of Connect Infobahn Australia (CIA, ~2003); defunct with CIA.

events.details: Wound down with CIA (Connect Infobahn Australia). Homepage content last changed 5 Sep 2011, then froze — the same page was recaptured unchanged through Sep 2017, indicating the retail site stopped being maintained around 2011 (the earlier 'by Jul 2010' bound was too early).
source: https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=ciadsl.com.au (last distinct homepage digest 20110905; identical captures recaptured through 20170924)
